title: Review: sliding-log rate limiter
claimed_change:
Add throttle.limiter.SlidingLogLimiter(limit, window_ms, clock) next to FixedWindowLimiter. clock() returns integer milliseconds from a monotonic (non-decreasing) source; limit and window_ms must be positive ints (ValueError otherwise, bools rejected), as for FixedWindowLimiter.
- allow(key) returns True and records the request iff fewer than limit requests for that key were allowed in the half-open interval (now - window_ms, now]; a request made exactly window_ms ago no longer counts. Rejected requests are never recorded.
- retry_after(key) returns the number of milliseconds until allow(key) would succeed (0 if it would succeed now), without recording anything.
- Pruning is lazy: a key's expired timestamps are dropped when that key is next used, and a key whose log becomes empty is removed. The limiter must be safe to call from several threads.
- Add tests.
